creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A drag is pinned to the pane and re-placed after every scroll (a_2ADMeD8nM). A double or triple click is not, because libghostty exports no way to read back which cells its own word or line selection covered - `ghostty_surface_read_selection` hands over the text and nothing hands over the bounds. Pinning the one cell that was clicked would be worse than leaving it: the first scroll would replace a word with a single cell.

Two ways out, and the second needs no upstream. Ask ghostty for a getter that answers a selection's start and end. Or drive the click count back in: the view sees `NSEvent.clickCount`, and re-driving two presses at the projected cell would re-select the word there, which is the same word the text carried with it. The second is timing-dependent - libghostty counts a repeat from `mouse-click-repeat-interval` and a cell's width - so it wants measuring against a real surface before it is trusted.

Until then a word selection scrolled over is the old bug in miniature, over one word rather than a paragraph.
title: 🖱️ A word or line selection still drifts when the pane scrolls
